Each page here takes one concept from two standard references, explains it briefly with the key equations, and gives you a widget to change the inputs and watch the result.

- **Quantitative genetics**: D. S. Falconer and T. F. C. Mackay, *Introduction to Quantitative Genetics*, 4th ed.
- **Cultivar development**: W. R. Fehr, *Principles of Cultivar Development*, Vol. 1.

The pages are study aids, not a substitute for the books. Chapter references point back to the source so you can read the full derivation.

**Selection.** [Heritability and response to selection](quantgen/heritability-selection.qmd) · [Selection intensity](quantgen/selection-intensity.qmd) · [Expected gain per cycle and per year](cultivar/expected-gain.qmd)

**Inbreeding and crossbreeding.** [Inbreeding depression](quantgen/inbreeding-depression.qmd)
